LUA_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install lua. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

LUA_VERSION.description: Specific version of lua to install.

LUA_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading lua binary or archive artifacts.

LUA_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying lua available remote releases.

LUA_RUN_TESTS.description: Whether to fetch and execute the official upstream lua-X.Y.Z-tests suite (all.lua) after building Lua from source.

LUA_TESTS_URL.description: Optional explicit URL for the official Lua test suite archive (defaults to https://www.lua.org/tests/lua-{VERSION}-tests.tar.gz).
